note: spring5-security-batch: HttpHeaders is no longer a Map in Spring 7 (containsKey / keySet → containsHeader / headerNames) — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|keySet` (c4ff664861) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|containsKey` (d726a7c52e)
response:
<analysis>Spring Framework 7's HttpHeaders no longer implements MultiValueMap / Map: containsKey(name) is containsHeader(name), keySet() is headerNames(). The script renames those calls on HttpHeaders variables named in the errors (the error's location gives the variable).</analysis>
<script>
import re

RENAMES = (("containsKey(", "containsHeader("), ("keySet()", "headerNames()"))


def fix(p):
    names_by_file = {}
    for e in p.errors:
        m = re.match(r"variable (\w+) of type org\.springframework\.http\.HttpHeaders", e.get("location") or "")
        if e.get("file") and m and p.exists(e["file"]):
            names_by_file.setdefault(e["file"], set()).add(m.group(1))
    for path, names in sorted(names_by_file.items()):
        text = p.read(path)
        new = text
        for name in sorted(names):
            for old, repl in RENAMES:
                new = re.sub(r"\b" + name + r"\." + re.escape(old), name + "." + repl, new)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
        p.log(f"{path}: HttpHeaders Map API -> containsHeader / headerNames for {', '.join(sorted(names))}")
</script>
